title: A RUNTIME OBSERVATION -- a record that something a runtime claims was seen to happen
description: ADR-022 decision 6. Written by the interpreter at the moment it observes an event it PROVIDES -- never authored by a host, because a claim and its proof would then have one author. A capability is PROVEN for a runtime only while such a record names both; everything else a host says about the runtime stays testimony. Observed state: it lives in the observed plane.

runtime.description: The runtime descriptor the event was observed through.

capability.description: The capability of the class vocabulary this event observes.

event.description: The event the interpreter provides that observed it.

evidence.description: What happened, in a sentence a later reader can check.
